module: Manages the list of interface elements to highlight during a tutorial. Each element is identified by an id (string); the state (ids in order of appearance, options, revision) is broadcast to the UI via the `tutorialHighlight` stream (guihooks.triggerStream). A modder or a tutorial script calls show/hide to turn a marker on or off.
usage:
ui_tutorialHighlight.show("btnGarage", {focus = true, scroll = true})
-- later
ui_tutorialHighlight.hide("btnGarage")
notes: Only the focus and scroll options (if true) are kept; if at least one is active, a `requestId` equal to the current revision is added.
The extension is in "manual" unload mode (setExtensionUnloadMode in onInit).
Each effective show/hide/hideAll increments the revision and rebroadcasts the stream; show rebroadcasts even if the id is already active.

show.desc: Enables the highlight of the id (appended at the end of the order if new), stores its options and broadcasts the state.

returns.desc: true if the id was just added; false if it was already active or if the id is invalid.

hide.desc: Removes the id from the highlight and broadcasts the state.

returns.desc: true if the id was active.

hideAll.desc: Removes all highlights and broadcasts the state.

returns.desc: { ids = string[], options = table<string, table>, revision = integer }

onUiReady.desc: Hook called when the UI is ready: rebroadcasts the current state.

onInit.desc: Initialization hook on extension creation: sets the unload mode to "manual".
